applies_why: The judge text addresses whether cited verses were answered and does not count them as unanswered witnesses.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The text expressly says the Isaiah 7:14 matter was answered in the named rounds, so it does not count those verses as unanswered witnesses.
